title.narrative: Central African Forest Initiative (CAFI) - Grant under the Tropical Forest Initaitive

description.narrative: The Congo Basin is the 2nd largest forest ecosystem in the world it absorbs CO2 equivalent to 4 % of the worlds emissions and provides livelihoods to 60 million people. The forest is threatened by increasing deforestation. The Danish contribution to CAFI aims at utilizing the forest as a nature-based solution to climate change, protect biodiversity while promoting sustainable socia-economic development.

The Danish contribution to CAFI is part of the Tropical Forest Initiative, which has the overall objective to reduce deforestation and degradation of national forest in response to global climate change, to protect biodiversity and to promote sustainable development.
The objective of the contribution to CAFI is to support investments and reforms to address forest loss and fight poverty in high-forest communities in the Congo Basin in Central Africa. The strategic objective of the engagement is to implement the Paris Agreement, fight poverty and develop sustainable and fulfill t the post-2020 biodiversity framework.
